titulo: Jan 1: the first name on the calendar is a friend's
caption:
Jan 1: the first name on the calendar is a friend's

Jan 1. A new calendar goes up, and before Cella writes anything of her own she puts a friend into the first free Saturday.

For whoever puts someone else on the calendar first.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a pink wall. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a royal blue one stands on the right looking away. Between them on the floor, a plain calendar block reads jan 1, then flips to sat 2. A royal blue square note pops up on top of it. The royal blue figure turns, its eyes go wide and then close in a smile and it pulses. Both lean in slightly toward each other and the black one smiles. The text stays: jan 1, the first name on it is theirs. The last card: for whoever puts someone else on the calendar first, Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella wrote a friend in first this year. Somebody got the first Saturday.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-dic-s4, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168 (3-ene). (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 14 seguidores y la semana de fiestas no separa causa de temporada: lectura de orden de magnitud.
